title: Multiple Classes – CSV Import – Group Method – Semicolon-Delimited Classes – Two LSC Records Created
description: AC 01.2/AC 03.1 — CRUD Testing — Validates that a Group CSV import with semicolon-separated classes creates two LSC records and shows correct formula field.
preconditions:
- SF org flag TRUE
- Class Alpha and Class Beta exist under Test Course MC
- CSV prepared: Teaching Method=Group, Class=Class Alpha;Class Beta
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff
steps_actions:
1. Navigate to SF Import Wizard (Lesson import)
2. Upload the CSV file
3. Map CSV columns to SF fields
4. Click Run Import
5. Navigate to the imported Lesson Schedule
6. Open the "Lesson Schedule Class" related list
7. Count LSC records and read Class values
8. Navigate to the imported Lesson and read its Class formula field
steps_result:
1. Import Wizard displayed
2. CSV uploaded; column preview shown
3. Mapping complete
4. Import success; records created
5. Lesson Schedule Detail displayed
6. LSC related list visible
7. 2 LSC records: one for Class Alpha, one for Class Beta
8. Class formula shows "Class Alpha, Class Beta"

title: Multiple Classes – CSV Import – Group Method – Two Classes – Students from Both Classes Auto-Assigned After Import
description: AC 01.2/AC 03.2 — CRUD Testing — Validates that after a Group multi-class CSV import, students from both classes are automatically assigned to the lesson.
preconditions:
- SF org flag TRUE
- Class Alpha: 2 enrolled students with active LAs
- Class Beta: 3 enrolled students with active LAs
- CSV: Teaching Method=Group, Class=Class Alpha;Class Beta
- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff
steps_actions:
1. Import the multi-class CSV
2. Wait up to 3 minutes for auto-assignment batch to complete
3. Navigate to the Lesson created by the import
4. Open the Student Session related list
5. Count sessions and confirm no duplicates
steps_result:
1. Import succeeds
2. Batch completes
3. Lesson Detail displayed
4. Student Session list displayed
5. Exactly 5 sessions (2 Class Alpha + 3 Class Beta); no duplicates

title: Multiple Classes – CSV Import – Individual Teaching Method – Class Column Ignored – Import Completes Without Class Assignment
description: BR-34 — Negative Testing — Validates that an Individual method CSV import ignores the Class column and creates no LSC records.
preconditions: - SF org flag TRUE\n- CSV: Teaching Method=Individual, Class=Class Alpha\n- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff
steps_actions:
1. Navigate to SF Import Wizard
2. Upload CSV with Teaching Method=Individual and Class=Class Alpha
3. Map columns and run the import
4. Navigate to the Lesson created by the import
5. Open the "Lesson Schedule Class" related list on the Lesson Schedule
steps_result:
1. Import Wizard displayed
2. CSV uploaded
3. Import runs without error
4. Lesson created; Class formula field is empty
5. LSC related list is empty (no LSC records created for Individual method)

preconditions: - SF org flag TRUE\n- CSV with Group method, 2 classes (semicolon-separated), teacher username, student sessions\n- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff
steps_actions:
1. Import the multi-class CSV
2. Navigate to the imported Lesson Schedule
3. Open the "Lesson Schedule Class" related list
4. Navigate to the Lesson and read Class formula field
5. Open Lesson Teacher related list
6. Open Student Session related list

2. Lesson Schedule Detail displayed

5. Lesson Teacher records exist
6. Student Session records exist
